findings.excerpt: title: "Rational points do not detect the group-scheme structure of alpha_p and mu_p"
findings.symptom: The title prints alpha_p and mu_p as ordinary baseline text, while the statement correctly uses the math symbols α_p and μ_p.
findings.suggested_repair: Use inline math or Unicode subscripts, for example $\alpha_p$ and $\mu_p$.

findings.excerpt: title: "h^1 of a line bundle equals the dimension of the space of dual sections"
findings.symptom: The title prints h^1 with the caret and numeral as literal text; this is the cohomological dimension h^1 used in the body.
findings.suggested_repair: Format the notation as $h^1$ or use a Unicode superscript.

findings.excerpt: title: "First blowup of the cusp y^2=x^3"
findings.symptom: The title prints the cusp equation with literal caret characters rather than as mathematical notation.

findings.excerpt: title: "E is a k-algebra, the E_i are ideals, and commutator traces vanish"
findings.symptom: The title prints E_i with a literal underscore; the subscripted family notation is used in the item body.
findings.suggested_repair: Format the notation as $E_i$ or use a Unicode subscript.

findings.excerpt: title: "Obstructions to deformations lie in Ext^2 of the cotangent complex"
findings.symptom: The title prints Ext^2 with the caret and numeral as literal text, while the statement uses the Ext^2 group.

review_attestation.diagram_review: No high-likelihood missing diagrams or malformed rendered maps/relations found in the reviewed ItemBodies.
